about_the_game:
Thrud - Valkyrie Rising is a horde-survivor roguelite where you play as Thrud, daughter of Thor, battling against Loki’s powerful armies to save Asgard. Harness divine powers, collect mystical runes, and create unstoppable synergies as you face relentless hordes of enemies and monstrous bosses.

CHALLENGE FOES

The hordes of chaos will not relent. Battle through endless waves of monstrous creatures, each deadlier than the last. Face cunning enemies that increase in strength, pushing your skills to the limit as you fight to reclaim the realm of the gods.

GATHER THE POWER OF NORSE GODS

The Aesir do not abandon their own. Channel the might of Odin, Thor, Freyja, and more, gaining divine blessings that grant devastating abilities. Combine their gifts to create unstoppable builds and crush anything that stands in your way.

UNLOCK NEW ATTACKS

Shape the battlefield with powerful enhancements to your projectiles. Unlock devastating effects that trigger on hit, alter how your attacks fly, and modify the way you unleash your fury. Chain explosive combos, pierce through enemies, or rain destruction in every direction—forge a playstyle that turns the tide of battle in your favor.

LEVEL UP AND INCREASE YOUR SKILLS

With every battle, you grow stronger. Gain experience, unlock powerful upgrades, and shape your abilities to suit your playstyle. Stack game-breaking effects and push the limits of your power to survive against impossible odds.

COMPLETE QUESTS

The road to salvation is paved with trials. Take on challenging quests that test your skill and resolve, unlocking powerful rewards. Prove yourself worthy of the gods and carve actions into the halls of Fólkvangr.
